_note: Round 44: time and seasons. The calendar runs on the real date, so the world keeps going while you're away: a season is season_days real days, a year is four seasons. The hour is your own clock (Game.hour). Weather is rolled for each quarter of a day, per place (the surface, or a floor's kind of deep). Every effect uses the same keys as techniques; foe_* keys go to the monsters (Game.level_mod). Words here are Dev's to rewrite (briefs world_seasons, world_weather, festivals).

seasons.name: Thaw
seasons.desc: Spring in the valley. Meltwater runs down into the deep, and everything that grows grows faster.
seasons.tip: Herbs come up thick in the Thaw. It's the season to stock the pouch.

seasons.name: Blaze
seasons.desc: High summer. The forges of the deep run hot and so does your blood.
seasons.tip: In the Blaze you hit harder, and so does everything down there.

seasons.name: Harvest
seasons.desc: Autumn. Traders come down with full carts and the leaves come down with them.
seasons.tip: Harvest is the season for crafting and for selling: luck runs your way.

seasons.name: Frost
seasons.desc: Winter. The valley goes quiet under snow. Quiet is good for sitting.
seasons.tip: Frost slows the beasts and steadies the mind. Sit through the winter and you'll feel it.

night.name: Night
night.desc: The deep is hungrier at night. More of them, and worse -- but they carry more.

dawn.name: Dawn
dawn.desc: The first breath of the day. Qi comes easiest at dawn.

dusk.name: Dusk
dusk.desc: The light turns. Things become clear at dusk: insight comes easier.

rain.name: Rain
rain.desc: Steady rain. The herbs drink it up.

storm.name: Thunderstorm
storm.desc: Thunder over the valley. Lightning in the blood: telling blows land more often.

fog.name: Fog
fog.desc: Thick fog. Your spirit sense reaches further when your eyes can't.

heat.name: Heat haze
heat.desc: Shimmering heat. Fire qi is thick in the air.

snow.name: Snow
snow.desc: Snow falls on Eliet. Everything is muffled and still.

leaves.name: Leaf-fall wind
leaves.desc: A cold wind brings the leaves down.

qi_mist.name: Qi mist
qi_mist.desc: A cool mist of loose qi drifts through the halls. Breathe deep.

spore_drift.name: Spore drift
spore_drift.desc: Spores on the air. They close small wounds -- and feed the things that live here.

ash_fall.name: Ash fall
ash_fall.desc: Ash sifts down from somewhere above. It stings the eyes and dulls the beasts' noses.

cold_seep.name: Cold seep
cold_seep.desc: Cold creeps up through the stone. The beasts move slower; so do you.

tremor.name: Deep tremor
tremor.desc: The rock shivers now and then. Loose stone means loose ore: gathering pays more.

drip.name: Dripping dark
drip.desc: Water drips everywhere. The damp hides your footsteps.

thaw.name: Festival of First Lanterns
thaw.desc: Eliet hangs paper lanterns for everyone who went down and came back. The traders give a little off, and the elder has a gift for those who walk the deep.

blaze.name: Ember Night
blaze.desc: Bonfires in the square, and the smiths show off. A night for blades and bragging.

harvest.name: Harvest Moon
harvest.desc: The whole village eats together under the big moon. The traders' carts are full and the prices are kind.

frost.name: The Longest Night
frost.desc: Candles in every window until dawn, for the ones who didn't come back. A night to sit and remember.
